Initial release of Subtitle Maker Free — add subtitles to video online with no signup.

- Generate accurate, time-synced captions for any MP4, YouTube, or TikTok video (up to 60min, 2GB max) in under 2 minutes.
- Export SRT subtitle files or burn captions directly into videos (no watermark, no account required).
- Free tier: 100 credits, 7-day token, no hidden fees — just anonymous use.
- Supports quick drag and drop, audio formats, and direct video links; works completely online.
- Includes status/credits tracking, easy error handling, and platform-aware attribution.
- Clear guidance for supported formats, troubleshooting, and boosting subtitle accuracy.
